notes: Structure updated to incorporate services into the existing tree (no separate services taxonomy).
Codebase labeling unchanged: this file still represents 'L3' anchors, corresponding to the new L2 level in the proposed tree.
Biospecimens split into Animal Biospecimens and Human Biospecimens, re-cut by sample type rather than species/diagnosis.
Equipment, Instruments and Parts expanded to explicitly cover the full instrument lifecycle (install, calibrate, maintain, repair, relocate) in addition to hardware.
Controls, Calibrations and Standards renamed to Analytical & Reference Standards.
Descriptions for categories that gained new service-type subcategories were extended (not replaced) with a services clause so first-stage classification doesn't miss service products.

v4.0: added 13 new L2 (code-L3) categories covering CRO/pharma services (Histology & Pathology through Medical Affairs & Medical Communications); collapsed 4 imaging-modality Equipment nodes into 1 (Imaging & Microscopy); fixed stale cross-references to removed nodes (Caps & Closures, General Lab Consumables); added production-grade (research/GMP) tag language to Antibodies and Peptides & Amino Acids.

anchors.label: Lab Supplies and Consumables
anchors.description: Disposable and reusable laboratory consumables used in daily bench work. Includes tubes, microtubes, Eppendorf tubes, centrifuge tubes, conical tubes, plates, microplates, 96-well plates, pipette tips, filters, filter papers, filter membranes, cuvettes, flasks, Erlenmeyer flasks, beakers, glassware, Pyrex glassware, containers, bottles, vials, syringes, needles, safety supplies, gloves, nitrile gloves, PPE, protective wear, lab coats, goggles, labeling tape, markers, cleaning supplies, sterilization supplies, microscopy slides, cover slips, tubing, hoses, stopcocks, caps, closures, and general bench consumables.

anchors.label: Molecular Biology & Genomics
anchors.description: Reagents for molecular biology experiments including PCR, gene editing, RNA interference, and cloning. Includes PCR primers, probes, siRNA, shRNA, miRNA, gRNA, Cas9 and other Cas nucleases, restriction enzymes, DNA polymerases, RNA polymerases, ligases, kinases, nucleotides, dNTPs, rNTPs, oligonucleotides, and other DNA or RNA modifying enzymes. Products are typically identified by target gene, locus, or DNA/RNA region and by target species. Also includes related services such as custom gene synthesis, plasmid and vector construction, and outsourced sequencing runs.

anchors.label: Chemicals and Solvents
anchors.description: Laboratory chemicals, solvents, buffers, and reagent-grade materials identified by CAS number, molecular formula, or purity grade. Includes organic compounds, inorganic compounds, acids, bases, salts, ACS-grade chemicals, HPLC-grade solvents, deuterated solvents, reagent solutions, flammable liquids, corrosive materials, oxidizers, powders, crystals, and bulk chemical raw materials defined by molecular weight, purity percentage, and physical state (solid, liquid, gas, powder, crystal, solution, gel). Also includes chemical building blocks and screening libraries, bioactive small molecules, and related contract services such as custom and medicinal chemistry synthesis, analytical chemistry testing, chromatography and purification services, radiochemistry, and physical/structural analysis.

anchors.label: Antibodies
anchors.description: Primary and secondary antibodies for research, diagnostic, and therapeutic applications. Identified by target protein or epitope (e.g., CD4, CD8, p53, Beta-Actin, GAPDH, Ki-67, PD-L1, EGFR, HER2), host species (mouse, rabbit, goat, rat, donkey, chicken, sheep), clonality (monoclonal, polyclonal, recombinant monoclonal), reactivity species (human, mouse, rat), and application (flow cytometry, western blot, IHC, immunofluorescence, ELISA, immunoprecipitation, ChIP). Includes conjugated antibodies (FITC, PE, APC, HRP, biotin, Alexa Fluor), isotype controls, antibody fragments, and nanobodies. Also includes antibody validation services (specificity and application-specific validation) and custom antibody generation (monoclonal, polyclonal, recombinant, and hybridoma production, tagged by production grade: research-use or GMP).

anchors.label: Proteins and Peptides
anchors.description: Purified recombinant and native proteins, cytokines, growth factors, hormones, and peptides of biological origin. Includes recombinant proteins expressed in E. coli, HEK293, CHO, baculovirus, or yeast systems; cytokines (interleukins, interferons, TNF); growth factors (EGF, FGF, VEGF, TGF-beta, BMP); hormones; enzymes; albumin; fibronectin; collagen; peptide libraries; custom synthesized peptides; amino acid standards; and fusion proteins. Products are identified by source organism, expression system, form (lyophilized, liquid, frozen), purity, and biological activity. Also includes related contract services such as protein purification, characterization, engineering, and conjugation/labeling.

anchors.label: Kits and Assays
anchors.description: Pre-packaged multi-component kits and assay systems for laboratory detection, quantification, and analysis. Includes ELISA kits, ELISA development kits, cell isolation kits, nucleic acid extraction kits, DNA extraction kits, RNA extraction kits, protein quantification kits, BCA assay kits, Bradford assay kits, PCR kits, qPCR kits, cell viability assay kits, apoptosis assay kits, immunoassay kits, detection assay kits, substrates, blocking buffers, diluents, stabilizers, signal enhancers, lateral flow assays, and multiplex assay systems. Also includes flow cytometry assay kits and related contract services such as custom assay development and validation, and high-throughput screening (HTS).

anchors.label: Cells and Tissue Culture
anchors.description: Media, reagents, support materials, and biological materials for maintaining and growing cells in vitro. Includes culture media (DMEM, RPMI, MEM, IMDM, F-12, McCoy's), sera (fetal bovine serum FBS, horse serum, human serum), serum-free media, defined media, supplements, growth factors for cell culture, cryopreservation reagents, DMSO, freezing media, extracellular matrix proteins, Matrigel, collagen coatings, fibronectin coatings, laminin, dissociation reagents, trypsin, Accutase, cell culture plastics, flasks, dishes, multi-well plates for cell growth, cell lines, primary cells, stem cells, organoids, and living cells for research. Also includes primary cells and stem cells/iPSCs as standalone product categories, and related services such as organoid generation and custom cell culture.

anchors.label: Animal Biospecimens
anchors.description: Biological samples collected from animal sources, organized by sample type rather than species. Includes animal tissue (fresh, frozen, FFPE), blood and biofluids (whole blood, plasma, serum, cerebrospinal fluid), isolated cells and PBMCs, primary cells, and stem cells/iPSCs. Also includes related services: custom/prospective collection, biobanking and storage, and sample processing (histology, FFPE, dissociation). Products are tagged by species, disease/health status, and collection or preservation method rather than split into separate species-level categories.

anchors.label: Human Biospecimens
anchors.description: Biological samples collected from human donors, organized by sample type rather than diagnosis or indication. Includes human tissue (fresh, frozen, FFPE), blood and biofluids (whole blood, plasma, serum, cerebrospinal fluid, saliva, urine), isolated cells and PBMCs, primary cells, and stem cells/iPSCs. Also includes related services: custom/prospective collection under informed consent, biobanking and storage, and sample processing (histology, FFPE, dissociation). Products are tagged by disease state, treatment status, consent, annotation, and grade rather than split into separate diagnosis-level categories.

anchors.label: Animal Models
anchors.description: Research animal models and model organisms for in vivo studies. Includes mouse models, rat models, zebrafish models, guinea pig models, hamster models, non-human primate models, Drosophila, C. elegans, and other model organisms. Identified by species, genetic strain (C57BL/6, BALB/c, NOD/SCID, nude mice, Sprague Dawley, Wistar), and genetic modification status (wild-type, knockout, transgenic, knock-in, humanized, CRISPR-modified). Includes disease models, oncology models, immunodeficient models, reporter mouse lines, and inbred strains. Also includes related services such as colony and breeding management, and in vivo pharmacology/efficacy studies.

anchors.label: Equipment, Instruments and Parts
anchors.description: Laboratory instruments, scientific equipment, automated systems, accessories, replacement parts, and the full instrument lifecycle services that accompany them. Organized by instrument function: mass spectrometry and chromatography, sequencing and genomics platforms, flow cytometry and cell analysis, microscopy and imaging (confocal, electron/cryo-EM, high-content, spatial), liquid handling and automation, bioprocess and single-use systems, and general lab equipment (centrifuges, balances, incubators, shakers, autoclaves, and similar bench instruments). Also includes parts and spares, instrument consumables, and services across the instrument lifecycle: installation and qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), calibration, preventive maintenance, repair, service contracts, and relocation.

anchors.label: Analytical & Reference Standards
anchors.description: Reference materials, quality control samples, calibrators, and certified reference standards for laboratory assay validation and instrument calibration. Includes analytical standards, reference materials and certified reference materials (CRMs), quality control materials, and proficiency testing materials and programs. Defined by analyte or parameter being measured, matrix, concentration, and regulatory or certification status (FDA cleared, CE marked, RUO, IVD, NIST traceable). Renamed from 'Controls, Calibrations and Standards'; instrument calibration as a service now lives under Equipment, Instruments and Parts.

anchors.label: Furniture and Storage
anchors.description: Laboratory furniture, casework, and storage solutions for laboratory environments. Includes laboratory benches, lab tables, workstations, laboratory chairs, lab stools, seating, shelving units, storage shelves, laboratory cabinets, chemical storage cabinets, flammable storage cabinets, refrigerators, freezers, ultra-low temperature freezers (-80C freezers), cryogenic storage tanks, liquid nitrogen storage, sample storage boxes, cryogenic boxes, cryovial racks, tube racks, and general laboratory furniture and storage infrastructure.

anchors.label: General Office Supplies
anchors.description: Non-laboratory office and administrative supplies used in scientific and research workplaces. Includes paper, notebooks, pens, pencils, markers, writing instruments, binders, folders, staplers, tape, adhesives, printer supplies, toner cartridges, printer paper, computer accessories, desk accessories, and general administrative and stationery items used alongside laboratory operations.

anchors.label: Histology & Pathology
anchors.description: Services for preparing, staining, imaging, and interpreting tissue specimens to characterize morphology, pathology, and molecular expression patterns. Includes routine and specialized histology, immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, digital pathology, and pathologist review, typically performed on customer-supplied animal or human tissue specimens in support of preclinical and translational research.

anchors.label: Toxicology & Safety Assessment
anchors.description: GLP and non-GLP nonclinical safety studies characterizing the toxicological profile of a drug, biologic, or chemical candidate prior to or alongside clinical development. Includes general and repeat-dose toxicology, safety pharmacology, genetic toxicology, and specialty toxicology studies (e.g., reproductive, developmental, immunotoxicology, carcinogenicity), typically conducted in animal models under regulatory guidelines (ICH, OECD, FDA).

anchors.label: DMPK / ADME
anchors.description: Studies characterizing a compound's absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) and pharmacokinetic behavior in vitro and in vivo. Includes metabolic stability, metabolite identification, drug-drug interaction (CYP/transporter) studies, plasma protein binding, permeability (Caco-2, PAMPA), and in vivo PK/toxicokinetic studies supporting lead optimization and IND-enabling packages.

anchors.label: Bioanalysis
anchors.description: Quantitative and qualitative analysis of drugs, metabolites, and biomarkers in biological matrices to support pharmacokinetic, toxicokinetic, and immunogenicity assessments. Includes small-molecule and large-molecule (biologics) bioanalysis, ligand-binding and LC-MS/MS assays, immunogenicity/anti-drug antibody (ADA) testing, biomarker assays, and GLP/regulated method development and validation.

anchors.label: CMC, Analytical & QC
anchors.description: Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls analytical services supporting drug substance and drug product development, characterization, and release. Includes analytical method development and validation, stability studies, release and characterization testing, impurity and extractables/leachables (E&L) testing, microbiological/sterility testing, and raw material testing, typically performed under GMP.

anchors.label: Clinical Trial Services (CRO)
anchors.description: Operational and administrative services supporting the planning, execution, and oversight of clinical trials. Includes trial management and monitoring, site management, patient recruitment and retention, clinical data management, biostatistics, medical writing, and clinical supply chain and logistics.

anchors.label: Central Lab Services
anchors.description: Centralized clinical laboratory testing services supporting multi-site clinical trials with standardized, validated results. Includes routine safety labs (chemistry, hematology), specialty/esoteric testing, biomarker testing, flow cytometry, and kit build/logistics and sample management for global trial sites.

anchors.label: Biomarker & Companion Diagnostics
anchors.description: Development and validation of biomarker assays and companion diagnostic tests used to stratify patients, monitor disease, or guide treatment decisions. Includes biomarker assay development, companion diagnostic (CDx) development and regulatory co-development, clinical assay validation, and genomic/molecular profiling services.

anchors.label: Regulatory Affairs
anchors.description: Services supporting regulatory strategy and submissions to health authorities throughout drug development and post-approval. Includes regulatory strategy consulting, dossier and eCTD preparation, submissions and agency liaison, labeling development, and regulatory auditing and compliance support.

anchors.label: Pharmacovigilance & Drug Safety
anchors.description: Post-market and clinical-stage safety monitoring services for detecting, assessing, and reporting adverse events and safety signals. Includes individual case safety report (ICSR) processing, signal detection, aggregate safety reporting (PSUR/PBRER/DSUR), literature monitoring, and risk management plan support.

anchors.label: HEOR, RWE & Market Access
anchors.description: Health economics, outcomes research, and market access services supporting value demonstration and reimbursement strategy. Includes health economic and outcomes research (HEOR) modeling, real-world evidence (RWE) studies, systematic literature review, payer/value dossier development, and pricing and market access strategy.

anchors.label: Phase IV / Post-Marketing Studies
anchors.description: Post-approval research and surveillance activities characterizing a marketed product's real-world safety, effectiveness, and utilization. Includes observational studies, patient registries, late-phase interventional trials, and post-authorization safety studies (PASS).

anchors.label: Medical Affairs & Medical Communications
anchors.description: Scientific and medical communication services supporting evidence dissemination and healthcare provider/scientific engagement for a marketed or late-stage product. Includes medical writing and publications, medical communications, medical science liaison (MSL) support, and scientific advisory/KOL engagement services.
